baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for /api/session/signin route
baseline_findings.description: The /api/session/signin route is exposed without any authentication checks. This could allow unauthenticated users to perform the sign-in operation, potentially leading to unauthorized access or privilege escalation.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., requireAuth, passport.authenticate) is present in the guard_evidence or shown callers. The route handler requires authentication to ensure only authorized users can perform the sign-in operation.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication middleware (e.g., keystone.session.keystoneAuth) before the /api/session/signin route handler to enforce authentication.

baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for session route
baseline_findings.description: The '/api/session' route is exposed without any authentication or authorization checks. This allows any user to access this endpoint, which could potentially expose sensitive information about the session.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., isLoggedIn, requireAuth) was found in the guard evidence or shown callers. The route is exposed without any control to ensure that only authenticated users can access it.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication middleware to the '/api/session' route to ensure that only authenticated users can access it. For example: router.get('/api/session', requireAuth, require('../api/session/get'));

baseline_findings.title: Missing authentication for /api/session/signout route
baseline_findings.description: The /api/session/signout route is exposed without any authentication checks. This could allow an attacker to sign out of a user's session without proper authorization.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check (e.g., isLoggedIn, requireAuth) was found in the guard_evidence or shown callers. The route is exposed without any control to ensure that only authenticated users can access it.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an authentication middleware to the /api/session/signout route to ensure that only authenticated users can sign out of their sessions.

baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for file upload endpoint
baseline_findings.description: The /api/cloudinary/upload route does not have any authentication, authorization, ownership, session, or input-validation checks. This allows any user to upload files without proper validation or restrictions.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication check is present in the function or its callers. The route does not require any control as it is a public endpoint for file uploads, but it should at least ensure that only authenticated users can upload files to prevent unauthorized access and potential abuse.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Implement authentication checks to ensure that only authenticated users can access this endpoint. This could involve requiring the user to be logged in or using an API key for authorization.

baseline_findings.title: Missing access control for file upload endpoint
baseline_findings.description: The /api/s3/upload endpoint allows any authenticated user to upload files without proper authorization or ownership checks. This can lead to unauthorized data uploads and potential security risks.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: No authentication, authorization, ownership, session, or input-validation check was detected on this function or any shown caller. The endpoint allows any authenticated user to upload files without proper role-based access control.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Implement role-based access control to ensure that only authorized users can upload files. This may involve checking the user's role and ensuring they have permission to perform file uploads.
